summary: Attorney-PDF reads for Legal Invoice Review (Issue #9 step 2b): append-only legal_invoice_extractions (raw model output, normalized matters, AP line map, validation problems, status), legal_invoice_items.extraction_id, the 'pdf_entry' service-date source, and the draft-save function persisting extraction_id. No GL, AP, owner-ledger or homeowner data is created or changed.

preflight.name: legal_invoice_extractions does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'legal_invoice_extractions'

preflight.name: legal_invoice_items.extraction_id does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'legal_invoice_items' AND column_name = 'extraction_id'

preflight.name: no saved item uses a source value the new constraint would reject
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM legal_invoice_items WHERE service_date_source NOT IN ('line_text', 'invoice_service_period', 'pdf_entry', 'staff', 'none')

expected_changes: Creates the empty, append-only table legal_invoice_extractions (service role SELECT/INSERT only; row-level security on; browser roles revoked) bound to both the PDF (source_sha256) and the payable as it stood at read time (payable_fingerprint + payable_snapshot, both required), with its status and fingerprint CHECKs and an index on (ap_invoice_id, created_at).
Adds legal_invoice_items.extraction_id (nullable FK) and widens the service-date source CHECK to include 'pdf_entry'. Existing items are untouched.
Replaces legal_review_save_draft() so it also persists extraction_id and refuses an extraction that belongs to a different invoice; everything else is unchanged from 473.
No GL, AP, owner-ledger, journal or homeowner data is created or changed.

verify.name: the service-date source accepts pdf_entry
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'legal_invoice_items_service_date_source_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%pdf_entry%'

verify.name: the save function carries the extraction guard
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'legal_review_save_draft' AND prosrc LIKE '%legal_review_extraction_not_for_invoice%'
